title: Don Kissick on Affordability in Ohio
description:
‘Sound of Ideas’ host ‎⁨@_StephanieHaney asked Ohio governor candidate Don Kissick the following question on affordability: 

As Ohioans struggle to make ends meet, what would you do as governor to help people afford everyday necessities, like gas, groceries, housing costs and utility payments?
